sonnet.problem: Cards 5 and 7 already tell the baker that the disciples forgot bread and have only one loaf, and card 6 asks about it. That gives away the answer to card 9, 'The fact that they have no bread'. The other two answers (which Pharisee to watch, where Herod might be) are plainly off, so the card needs no reasoning.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The joke line 'Jesus says leaven, and all they hear is BREAD' states what the disciples heard and why they started discussing bread. The text only says 'So they began to discuss with one another the fact that they had no bread.' It never says they misheard 'leaven' as bread, and it doesn't spell out how the warning and their discussion connect.
sonnet.rule: He never adds why someone did, said or thought something unless the text says why.
